Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
(sorry, the previous post is full of typos !!)

Hi !
this day I was playing a monster deck with the monstruous enkidu...

i manage to torporize several vampires.
At some points, I have a Gangrel conspiracy and forced march in hand.
My plan i simple : eat and then untap.
As i go to diablerize one of them, i play Gangrel conspiracy.
Then someone plays Sudden Reversal. Bad luck.
But somewoh i was lucky enough to tape-ma-chatte (which in this case
means i top decked with an incredible luck) to replace my gangrel
conspiracy with Rebirth.
hoping that no one has a direct intervention in hand (tape-ta-chatte), i
want to play rebirth on the same action.

the lack of sleep makes the other player agree.

But, after thinking about that, was i really lucky or was it too late ?

card text on Gangrel conspiracy says "cancel a blood hunt called"
while card text on rebirth says "no blood hunt may be called".
so i guess it may be after some sort of resolution.

thank you
reyda (TTC in progress)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, it is too late.

Rebirth is played before beginning the blood hunt referendum.
Gangrel Conspiracy can only be played later, when the referendum passes.
